source_interfaces: Prove exactly Theorem1.8: for fixed n>=1, k>=2 and a partition mu of n, the unrestricted and regular-semisimple target cycle-type probabilities of products of independent uniform regular elliptic GLn(Fq) matrices both tend to1/z_mu as prime powers q tend to infinity. These two coordinated limits are one outcome. All new regular-semisimple primary-character flag counting, finite-field character sums and uniform bounds for q-dependent character indices are retained. Exact finite-q formulas and later polynomiality questions are uncounted context. The original precisely stated Frobenius finite-group factorization formula, Green complex irreducible-character construction and degree formula, ordinary character orthogonality and rational-canonical/regular-semisimple conjugacy enumeration are named foundations. All source-local flag enumeration, specialized character evaluation, Mobius character-sum and uniform asymptotic estimates remain fully authored core rather than assumptions. Complete original native author body, inline TikZ diagrams, formulas, all statement/proof indices and comments/percent guards retained byte-exact. Remaining open questions in the final unselected section stay visibly uncounted. No mathematical refereeing, counterexample tests, repaired formula or added proof is supplied. The authentic author equation(63), native2102, uses xyx^{-1} in its parabolic count while adjacent formulas use xgx^{-1}; this minor variable-letter quirk is retained and separately noted, without mathematical repair.
